title: Genotype-phenotype links (flying fish)
headline: No flying-fish molecular data exists, so every gene link is a proxy-fish record (zebrafish via ZFIN and Bgee, medaka via Bgee), now vetted: the pectoral fin has 166 genes required for it under standard conditions, 1 verified gain-of-function gene (kcnk5b) sufficient to enlarge it, and 982 expressed in it; only 16 of 257 cell types have a zebrafish-anatomy equivalent, so the cell layer (14 with a record) is capped by the ontology crosswalk, not by the data.
